entries.citation_caveat: The repo's citation string is wrong: authors are Zhu et al., not Sun et al., and the year is 2021 (online Oct 2020), not 2020. Note the matrix is braised CHICKEN, not a high-moisture plant-protein melt -- this is a surrogate transfer, which the repo's own 'notes_on_limits' already flags. The paper covers CML/CEL kinetics only; it does not supply dityrosine diffusion-limited kinetics or glyco-conjugate data, so those parameters need a separate source. The previously stored DOI (10.1016/j.meatsci.2020.108151 = Jo et al. on plasma-treated mushroom in ground ham) is unrelated.
